title: HiSA: Sparsifying the Hidden Dimension of RoPE Attention in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.26363v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Attention in large language models (LLMs) scores every query against every key with a full dot product. We investigate whether this dot product must be computed completely for attention to be effective. We propose Hidden Sparse Attention (HiSA), which keeps the query and key projections intact but only computes a partial dot product, following a static, parameter-free rule set by the token positions: attention becomes sparse in the hidden (feature) dimension, an axis much less explored than token sparsity, rather than over tokens as in almost all sparse attention methods. Based on the structure of rotary position embeddings (RoPE), we decompose keys and queries into parts which can be omitted when computing attention. By training LLMs from scratch with HiSA, we find that this partial dot product does not hurt but improves performance compared with the complete product while computing only about a third of the query-key products. translated_title: HiSA：对大语言模型中RoPE注意力的隐藏维度进行稀疏化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）中的注意力机制通过完整的点积将每个查询与每个键进行评分。我们研究了为了让注意力机制有效，这个点积是否必须被完整计算。我们提出了隐藏稀疏注意力，它保持查询和键的投影不变，但仅计算部分点积，遵循一个由token位置设定的静态、无参数的规则：注意力在隐藏（特征）维度上变得稀疏——这是一个相比token稀疏性被探索得少得多的维度——而不是像几乎所有稀疏注意力方法那样在token维度上进行稀疏化。基于旋转位置嵌入的结构，我们将键和查询分解为在计算注意力时可以省略的部分。通过使用HiSA从头训练LLM，我们发现这种部分点积不仅不会损害性能，反而相比完整点积提升了性能，同时只需计算约三分之一的查询-键乘积。
tldr: 提出HiSA方法，基于RoPE结构将注意力点积在隐藏（特征）维度上进行稀疏化，仅需计算约三分之一的查询-键点积就能在LLM训练中提升而非损害性能。
en_tdlr: HiSA sparsifies attention along the hidden (feature) dimension based on RoPE structure, computing only about one-third of the query-key dot products while improving rather than hurting LLM performance.
